description: Right-side AI chat powered by the ZCode runtime (Start Plan / BigModel).
capability.untrusted: Chat may send workspace context to the configured provider bridge.
config.title: ZCode / Cursor
config.activeBrain: Top-level AI brain (ZCode and Cursor are peers).
config.activeBrain.zcode: ZCode — Start Plan / BigModel via shared credentials.
config.activeBrain.cursor: Cursor — official Agent CLI over ACP.
config.providerMode: ZCode provider (when active brain is ZCode).
config.providerMode.startPlan: ZCode Start Plan — account JWT / Start Plan quota.
config.providerMode.bigmodel: BigModel — OAuth session from shared ZCode credentials.
config.cursor.agentPath: Path to the Cursor `agent` CLI binary (default ~/.local/bin/agent).
config.cursor.model: Cursor model id (empty = CLI default). Run `agent --list-models`.
config.model: Active model id (ZCode defaults: Start Plan GLM-5.3-Flash / GLM-5.2 / GLM-5-Turbo; BigModel GLM-5.3 / GLM-5.3-Flash).
config.reasoningLevel: Thinking intensity for the active model (e.g. low / high / max).
config.chatFontSize: Font size (px) for the AI Chat view: messages, reasoning, tool rows, code blocks, and the input box.
config.bridge.mode: How ZCode chat runs (ignored when brain is Cursor).
config.bridge.mode.agent: Call BigModel Coding Plan / Start Plan and run a local file tool loop (default).
config.bridge.endpoint: HTTP endpoint for bridge mode=http (OpenAI-compatible or ZCode sidecar).
config.oauth.apiOrigin: ZCode API origin used for CLI OAuth init/poll (default https://zcode.z.ai).
container.title: AI Chat
chat.description: ZCode agent with Start Plan / BigModel providers.
chat.command.provider: Show or switch the active provider mode.
